prompt: You are maintaining a long-lived personal memory store for a coding agent. In the current workspace, there are three project notes and a session log. Your task is to consolidate durable facts, lessons learned, and entities into the AgentMemory database at ~/.agent-memory/memory.db, then produce a short human-readable summary file named memory_summary.txt in the workspace. The summary should mention the most important facts, at least one lesson, and the tracked entities with their roles. Use the provided input files only; do not invent information. After storing the memory, write the summary so another agent can quickly understand what was learned in this session.
